description: Short-distance variant of the watchdog case. The plan p1 (pre-search ETA estimate 1799 s = 29:59) is short: comparison budget = plan start 0 + 3000. The remaining ETA on the current route is 1799 s, so the searches outside the plan (avoid chip r1 at 1000, the reroute r2 at 30000) start short (team decision 2026-11-25: class fixed at each start from the valid remaining ETA, the plan's class is not inherited): watchdog = start 1000 + 5000. At 6000 Rust detects engine_stuck from now_mono_ms; the slot stays occupied (a reroute request only sends cancel, no start) until r1's search_finished, then r2 starts short. 'expect_starts' lists the start{req_id, priority, distance_class} each step must emit.
